title: IncrementalClassificationNaiveBayes Fit
text: Fit incremental naive Bayes classification model, 4 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Prior data type} sets Data type of prior term; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental naive Bayes classification model, {Add input port for observation weights} adds second input port for observation, {Add input port for resetting trained learner} adds input port for resetting trained incremental, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Internal states data type} sets the data type of internal states Inherit, {Internal states data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of internal states for range checking, {Internal states data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of internal states for range checking, {Prior data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of prior term for range checking and {Prior data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of prior term for range checking. Values come from the instance.
